# Wash 66

> Wash 66 is a soft-touch express exterior car wash at 7 Pettingill Road, Quispamsis, NB E2E 6B1, Canada. It offers single washes, unlimited monthly memberships (one wash per day) using an RFID windshield tag, auto detailing by appointment, and covered vacuum bays. Open every day 8 am to 7 pm, holidays 10 am to 6 pm, closed Christmas Day. Phone 506-847-7627, email info@wash66.com.

## Washes and prices (CAD, before HST)

- Good: $12 per wash, or $30 per month as a membership
- Better: $16 per wash, or $36 per month as a membership
- Best: $20 per wash, or $42 per month as a membership
- 3 months paid up front: Good $81, Better $97, Best $113
- Buy 6 months of any membership, get the 7th month free
- Vacuums are free with any wash or membership, $5 on their own

## Membership terms

- One vehicle per membership; anyone driving the tagged vehicle can use it
- Valid one month from the date of purchase and renews automatically
- Cancelling needs at least 20 days' notice before the billing date; changes are made on site
- One wash per day maximum
